His argument against critics questioning the aircraft is that anyone challenging this purchase is a demonically influenced troll being used by Satan to attack the anointed. The video examines how this machine every one of these prosperity guys builds: invent an emergency, wrap it in a Bible verse, and let the shame do the collecting. It isn't faith. pinned_comment: Marcus Wray said holding back your money means you're robbing God. Not robbing him. Robbing God. How do you explain to a friend that a preacher told their congregation that withholding a donation is a sin against the Almighty? What line does a person cross before the church stops being a church and becomes a collection operation?

He called anyone questioning a fourth private jet a 'demonically influenced troll used by Satan to attack the anointed.' So the only way to ask why a pastor needs a twelve-seat aircraft is to be possessed by a literal demon. That's the defense. Airtight. Tell me if you've ever seen a more absurd way to shut down a question.

The whole machine is the same: invent an emergency, wrap it in a scripture, let the guilt do the collecting. Wray built a fundraising operation that happens to meet on Sundays. If you've ever been in a room where a leader made you feel guilty for not giving more, what finally made you walk out? Or what kept you there?
